## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: the admitted pure selection contract once —
   shared first-valid grade selection within the frozen valid-grade set +
   authorized append-only invalidation/immutable revisions (PADR-R5-1 A.1
   items 5–7, A.3, A.4; design 14 F2/X6). Reuse lower-layer codecs/stores;
   consume predecessor contracts unchanged (AC-1, AC-2).
2. Positive: owner-validated causes/pins/watermarks; authorized
   append-only invalidation; failure→valid zero→failure retains zero;
   historical watermark resolves historical selection (AC-1).
3. Negative: later higher reward, duplicate instrument, wrong
   subject/submission/oracle/set and unauthorized correction cannot win;
   base `budget_exhausted` and veto remain distinct; invalidated evidence
   unavailable until valid replacement (AC-2).
4. Ownership/evidence: REQ-E-204 + REQ-E-103 (primary) and REQ-E-102
   (contributing) resolved to numbered checks + actual evidence; achieved
   D/E recorded separately from owed R/P/actual-execution E; contributor
   evidence owed to R5.10/R5.11/R5.13/R5.14 (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: fails-without regression; `cargo fmt --all --check`
   + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode checks only if
   touched; counts recorded; scratch stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green scope; REQ ids stamped; owed predicates as

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-eval/src/selection.rs` (new module — the pure contract,
   no eval→ledger edge): `ValidGradeSet` (frozen valid-grade set:
   subject/submission/oracle/policy pins + eligible members +
   `eligible_set_ref()` content address), `GradeAttempt` (owner-validated
   fact: durable coordinate, pins, cause citations, outcome, seq),
   `GradeOutcome` (Decided | OracleFailure), `SelectionRevision`
   (`{revision_id, reason, supersedes, authority, watermarks[],
   eligible_set_ref}` per A.3 — canonical JSON), `RevisionLog`
   (append-only; `append` enforces authority/supersedes/immutability),
   `select_grade` + `select_grade_at(watermark)` (first-valid within the
   set; pin/cause/dup/conflict checks; watermark-scoped reproduction),
   `plan_disposition` (stop-derived class restored incl.
   `budget_exhausted`; raw grade + veto separate axes; `Pending`
   admission state / `OracleFailure` when all evidence unavailable),
   `SelectionError` typed refusals.
2. `crates/hh-eval/src/lib.rs` — `pub mod selection`.
3. `crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_9.rs` — AC-1/AC-2 battery (scratch/pure —
   no store needed: the contract is pure; owner validation = the
   contract's structural pin/cause/watermark checks over the owner-
   supplied facts).
4. ADR-0388 — owned landing decisions (first-valid-per-member ordering,
   supersedes-chain semantics, watermark coverage, unauthorized-correction
   refusal, consumer-side durable validation owed to R5.11/R5.14).
5. Gate-status verbatim into contract; run ledger; PR; close.
